request.state:
We deleted our most-requested feature last month.

It had 2,000 upvotes on our roadmap. Usage after launch: 3% of accounts. Support tickets it caused: 22% of the total.

The lesson: votes measure what people say, not what they do. Before you build the top-voted thing, ask 10 voters to show you the workaround they use today. If they have none, they will not use yours either.
